title: 1946 military search of Swedish lakes for ghost rockets

tellings.quote:
And in 1946, as we talked about the
ghost rockets, uh, the military were
looking for them in several different
lakes around Sweden. All they found were
indentations at the bottom.

plain: In 1946, during the wave of "ghost rockets", unexplained rocket-like objects reported in the skies over Sweden that year, the Swedish military reportedly searched the bottoms of several lakes around the country for crashed objects. A researcher named Clas Svahn tells it, without naming a source, and says that "all they found were indentations at the bottom." If true, it would mean something hit the lakes but nothing was ever recovered.
